hypothesis_md:
# Low-vol vs market style rotation

**Slug:** `family-lowvol-rotation`  
**Family:** lowvol-rotation  
**Primary object:** USMV/SPY low-vol-vs-market relative momentum.

When the low-volatility style is not leading the market, hold TQQQ; when
defensive low-vol leadership becomes strong, hold BIL. 60-session relative
signal at close, next-open fill, long-only, 2% band, 1 bp headline.
